annotations.title: Format a post for a platform

description: Fit post text (and an optional link) to one platform's length limit: x (280, links count 23), bluesky (300), threads (500), linkedin (3,000), telegram (4,096) or instagram (2,200). Shortens at a word boundary with an ellipsis and keeps the link whole. Returns the post, its measured length, the limit and whether it was shortened. Formatting only: nothing is posted.
name: format_post
title: Format a post for a platform
